maturity_signs: Grains become mature and the crop changes from green to a yellowish or golden colour.
Most grains should have reached the appropriate maturity stage before harvest.
harvest_timing: Harvest when the crop has reached the recommended maturity stage.
Avoid harvesting too early because immature grains can reduce grain quality.
harvest_method: Harvest manually or mechanically using a suitable method for the farm.
Handle the harvested crop carefully to reduce grain loss.
post_harvest: Thresh the harvested crop appropriately.
Dry the grains to a suitable safe moisture level before storage.
Store cleaned and dried grain in a clean, dry place.
precautions: Avoid harvesting during unsuitable wet conditions where possible.
Prevent harvested grain from getting contaminated with soil or moisture.

maturity_signs: Cotton bolls open fully and the lint becomes clearly visible.
Harvest when bolls are sufficiently open and the lint is dry.
harvest_timing: Pick cotton when bolls are properly opened and conditions are dry.
Multiple pickings may be required as different bolls mature at different times.
harvest_method: Pick mature cotton carefully to reduce contamination.
Avoid mixing wet material with dry harvested cotton.
post_harvest: Keep harvested cotton clean and dry.
Protect cotton from rain and excess moisture.
Store in a clean and dry location.
precautions: Avoid harvesting wet cotton where possible.
Remove visible foreign material from harvested cotton.

maturity_signs: Pods develop fully and show appropriate maturity characteristics.
Leaves may begin yellowing as the crop approaches maturity.
harvest_timing: Harvest when the majority of pods have reached suitable maturity.
Avoid very early harvesting because immature pods may reduce yield and quality.
harvest_method: Lift or dig the plants carefully to reduce pod losses.
Shake off excess soil before drying.
post_harvest: Dry the harvested pods properly before storage.
Remove damaged or contaminated pods.
Store in a dry, well-ventilated place.
precautions: Avoid leaving harvested pods wet for long periods.
Prevent contamination with soil and fungal growth.

maturity_signs: Fruit develops the appropriate colour and firmness for the intended market.
Harvest stage depends on whether the fruit is for local use, transport or storage.
harvest_timing: Harvest fruits at the appropriate maturity stage for the intended market.
Regular picking can help maintain continued fruit production.
harvest_method: Harvest fruits carefully to avoid bruising and stem damage.
Use clean containers for harvested fruits.
post_harvest: Sort fruits according to maturity and quality.
Keep harvested fruits in a cool, clean and protected place.
Handle fruits gently during transportation.
precautions: Avoid rough handling and dropping fruits.
Do not mix damaged or diseased fruits with healthy produce.

maturity_signs: Fruit colour and firmness change according to the intended harvest stage.
For dry chilli, fruits should be harvested at suitable maturity before drying.
harvest_timing: Harvest at the maturity stage required for fresh or dry chilli production.
Multiple pickings may be required.
harvest_method: Pick fruits carefully without excessive damage to the plant.
Use clean harvest containers.
post_harvest: Sort harvested chilli according to quality.
For dry chilli, dry properly before storage.
Store dried produce in a dry and clean place.
precautions: Avoid mixing diseased or damaged fruits with healthy produce.
Protect harvested produce from excess moisture.

maturity_signs: Harvest fruits when they reach the suitable market maturity and size.
Fruits should generally remain firm and suitable for the intended market.
harvest_timing: Harvest regularly once fruits reach marketable maturity.
Do not allow fruits to become excessively over-mature.
harvest_method: Cut or pick fruits carefully to reduce damage.
Use clean containers during harvesting.
post_harvest: Sort fruits based on quality and maturity.
Keep harvested fruits protected from excessive heat and moisture.
precautions: Avoid bruising fruits during harvesting and transport.
Remove damaged or diseased produce.

maturity_signs: Fruits become sufficiently developed and show the appropriate maturity characteristics for the intended market.
Harvest maturity depends on the variety and transport requirements.
harvest_timing: Harvest bunches at the appropriate maturity stage for the intended market.
Consider transport distance when selecting harvest maturity.
harvest_method: Cut the bunch carefully to avoid damage to fruits and the plant.
Handle harvested bunches gently.
post_harvest: Keep harvested bunches protected from direct sun and physical damage.
Sort and grade fruits according to quality.
Use clean storage and transport conditions.
precautions: Avoid dropping or damaging bunches.
Keep harvested fruits away from contaminated surfaces.

maturity_signs: Fruit reaches the suitable maturity stage based on variety, colour, size and other maturity characteristics.
Harvest stage depends on whether the fruits are for local consumption or longer-distance transport.
harvest_timing: Harvest mature fruits at the appropriate stage for the intended market.
Avoid harvesting excessively immature fruits unless the marketing system requires it.
harvest_method: Harvest fruits carefully using suitable picking methods.
Avoid dropping fruits because bruising can reduce quality.
post_harvest: Sort fruits according to size and quality.
Handle harvested fruits carefully during grading and transport.
Keep produce protected from excessive heat.
precautions: Avoid damaging the fruit skin during harvest.
Separate damaged or diseased fruits from healthy produce.

maturity_signs: Neem fruits reach suitable maturity and develop the expected colour and appearance.
Seeds inside mature fruits should be sufficiently developed.
harvest_timing: Collect mature fruits when they are suitable for the intended seed or planting use.
Avoid collecting severely damaged or diseased fruits.
harvest_method: Collect fruits carefully from the tree or ground depending on the intended use.
Use clean containers for collection.
post_harvest: Clean and dry seeds properly before storage.
Store planting material in suitable dry conditions.
precautions: Avoid storing wet seeds for long periods.
Remove damaged or mouldy material.

maturity_signs: Harvest maturity depends on the intended timber production system and planned rotation.
Tree size, age and plantation management objectives should be considered.
harvest_timing: Harvest according to the planned plantation rotation and management objectives.
Follow applicable local forestry and plantation regulations.
harvest_method: Use appropriate and safe forestry harvesting practices.
Plan felling and transport to reduce unnecessary damage.
post_harvest: Process and store timber appropriately.
Keep harvested timber protected from unnecessary moisture and damage.
precautions: Follow applicable forestry rules and permissions.
Use safe procedures and trained personnel for timber harvesting.
